Postal.source: Retrospective WA 2025 processing timetable: only 69% of final formal postals were counted at receipt closure, about 95% by 21 March morning and 98% in the evening capture. The day-13 centre and two-day scale are broad replay assumptions, not known completion dates or cross-election calibration.

Absent.source: Retrospective WA 2025 calibration: absent formal counts were 81% complete on 23 March, 87% on 24 March, and approximately complete in the 25 March capture. No comparable WA 2021 reporting timetable is available.
